summary.text: Will Jobe is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 21 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Michael Young is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Will Jobe served in the U.S. Army, earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2012 and received a law degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and a minister.
Jobe was assigned to the House Ethics Committee and the Joint Committee on Legislative Research for 2025-2026.
